era: 2019 Rotten Tomatoes (captures 2019-03 to 2019-11): #fa320a red header with the white logo, the white search field and white uppercase MOVIES & DVDS / TV / NEWS / TICKETS & SHOWTIMES, 'What's the Tomatometer®? · Critics · SIGN UP | LOG IN' top right, grey 'TRENDING ON RT' bar with yellow label and Facebook/Twitter/Instagram/YouTube icons, a 1010px white column on #eee, uppercase Neusa section titles, Tomatometer and Audience Score, and the dark footer with 'Join The Newsletter'. Same site for every visitor.
